This feature genuinely introduces new data shapes (a new resolver-output JSON structure, a new `ownership_digest` field populating ADR-0021's `context_binding` block, and a new `check-component-coverage-verdict/v1` evidence-record schema consumed by `quality-gate`'s evidence bundle) so the 'No data changes' exemption does not apply, and no equivalent 'no migration required, because ...' statement is present to close the gap explicitly. Concrete failure mode: a downstream implementer authoring these new record/evidence shapes has no design-level guidance on whether any existing `quality-gate` evidence-bundle consumer needs compatibility handling, or whether any rollout/versioning discipline beyond the bare `schema` field value applies — left implicit rather than stated, unlike the other two Data Plan sub-fields which are explicit. This is not owned by precheck (precheck-result.json only records hash/status/legacy-design metadata, not Data Plan sub-field completeness).
